title: Sebi approves net settlement of cash market trades for mutual funds
description: India’s Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has greenlit the introduction of net settlement for mutual fund schemes, set to take effect on April 1, 2027. This initiative is designed to streamline funding requirements and boost market efficiency. Previously, net settlement was exclusive to foreign portfolio investors. Eligible transactions will now be confined to sales or purchases of a specific security, while cross-scheme netting will remain prohibited.
